preconditions.description: The length of string s is between 1 and 1000.
The number of palindromic messages k is between 1 and 1000.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'YES' if len(s) % k == 0 and all(is_palindrome(s[i:i+len(s)//k]) for i in range(0, len(s), len(s)//k)) else return_value == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if the string s can be divided into k palindromic substrings of equal length, otherwise 'NO'.
